notes.title: The Feast of the End: DomiHorror III Release Announcement
notes.notes:
The Feast of the End, the third installment in the DomiHorror series, arrives on January 25th (Saturday).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45380728/56e062d0da27fb446c516079bbf2de294e2cc5f3.png[/img]

Prepare to confront the twisted justice of the sinister sisters as they pursue their chilling goal of "salvation." With a perfect mix of suspenseful gameplay and immersive storytelling, The Feast of the End promises to deliver[b][u] a gripping horror and sexy experience like no other.[/u][/b]

This final chapter ties together the storylines of the previous installments, with an approximate playtime of 1–2 hours per game.
Can you outsmart the sisters, avoid capture, and uncover the truth behind their dark plans?

Mark your calendars and join us for the thrilling conclusion of the Feast series. Don't miss out!
